quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. The road splits, and you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light to tell drivers that left turns do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that cars parked in this area will be towed away.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways as you cross.
Always come to a full stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on a bridge over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right on a red light. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
A curve is ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a curve is coming. The arrow shows which direction the road curves. The sign recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Be ready to adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that shows a rule you must follow. You cannot make right turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You might damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
Your car will hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a winding road ahead. Slow down and be ready for the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to respond to red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians go first before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers that the road ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers that the road shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers a steep hill is coming and to adjust their speed to drive safely.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Check for pedestrians and traffic crossing the intersection. Wait for the intersection to be clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. This sign marks a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to hazards or unusual conditions ahead.

questions.question: What do these signs indicate?
questions.explanation: These object marker signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about objects or areas that are dangerous and should be avoided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people in the crosswalk or crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a yield sign is ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest legal speed you can drive on this road. If conditions are bad—rain, snow, ice—you must drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.
There are trucks on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means an action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a narrow bridge is ahead with narrow lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted in parking lots and shows reserved parking spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign shape and color mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign means no passing zone. This shape is only used for this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction zones ahead. This sign tells you the normal route is blocked and you must take a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to take the marked detour. The normal road has dangerous conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road hazards. This sign alerts you to a curve coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign means there is a barrier or island ahead. Drive to the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that you cannot park here at any time of day or night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road will soon be divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead has loose gravel on it.
The highway has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead has loose gravel on it.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazardous road conditions. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that loose gravel is on the road ahead. On gravel roads, your tires have less traction, so drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves left. You may see several chevron signs along a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn left only when light turns green.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows that there are multiple left turn lanes. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A left turn signal is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A left turn signal is ahead.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means wait for the left turn signal to turn green before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about hazards in construction zones. This sign tells drivers that a flagger is ahead and will be giving directions. Follow the flagger's instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Change to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When driving on a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering the road. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic merge in safely.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always give way to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction ahead. This sign tells you that penalties are stricter if you drive recklessly in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road conditions and hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may enter from a side road.

questions.question: What does this road sign tell you?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for exiting a highway.
The safe speed limit for entering a highway.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for exiting a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to drive carefully because wet roads can be slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or go straight.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and show rules you must follow. This sign tells you that from this lane, you may turn left or go straight at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and you must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and you must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane on the road ends ahead. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to hazards ahead and are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two one-way lanes with a median between them. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum speed you are allowed to drive on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction ahead. Slow down and be careful when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that buggies may be on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that deer may cross the road in this area. Be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What is the correct order of a traffic light from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and diamond-shaped. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you to follow a detour because the normal road is closed for construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction and maintenance work. This sign tells you that road work is happening ahead. Slow down and drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a playground is near. Watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead. Reduce your speed to 35 mph or less.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead. Be alert and slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that lanes are shifting ahead. Follow the new lane directions carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill slope is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Start to slow down your vehicle.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You can reduce your speed if you want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start to slow down your vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic will be entering from the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of roadwork.
Slow down because the road turns sharply ahead.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road turns sharply ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead makes a sharp turn. You should slow down before reaching this sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you of a steep downhill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake problems or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a detour will occur in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means drivers in the left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They tell you about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must follow what they say. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering or symbols. A detour sign shows you an alternate route around a road that is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (for example, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are only for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
A bus stop is coming up.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means large trucks are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and diamond-shaped with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you to a fire station nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or direction changes, and increase the distance between you and the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Get ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you which direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you that the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign is posted near intersections. It tells you not to enter the intersection if you cannot clear it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to an upcoming sharp turn. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up. Watch for traffic from all directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are heading the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to an upcoming stop sign. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that farm machinery may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road may be wet and slippery. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that a new lane will be added to the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the center lane can be used for left turns by cars going in both directions. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway and form a ramp. If you stay in your lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down and let trains cross. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is often posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns drivers not to enter the road from your direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the minimum legal driving speed. Do not drive slower than the speed posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road. Drive carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that from this lane, you can turn right or continue straight ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are not ideal. Always slow down when road or weather conditions are bad.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can park in this area, but only for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction work ahead. This sign tells drivers that the right lane will be closed due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only flows one way. You must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. A flagger controls traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a merge is ahead. Two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter from your current direction. It is not safe. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the divider or median.
